origin: hand-written from the published schema; every value invented
notes: Success envelope. Rows live at data.data and the time bucket column is granularity-suffixed (date__day for granularity=day), so the column name is derived from the request rather than fixed. data.metadata.truncated is the ONLY completeness attestation the surface offers: truncated=false is what lets a history page be published as complete, and query_time_ms / row_count are diagnostics. There is no cursor, so a truncated result cannot be resumed.
